description.value:
Cast 1 day of downtime

Frequency —, but see Requirement

Requirement You have not gained a mutation from this feat since your last level gain.

Cost 3 Vitae

Permanently graft a minor beneficial mutation onto yourself.

Choose one minor beneficial mutation from the Bloom Table's Runaway Mutation entries the GM has approved for your character, or propose a new one of comparable power with the GM. It is permanent and does not require maintenance. You may gain one this way per level.

cinderfall.incomplete: This card's entire payload is a Vitae-spend/gain beyond the bare pool, a Bloom Table roll/choice, Resonance, Load, Strain, or "Mk" grade -- none of which has any rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus. fleshmancer.vitae-pool.json's own SpecialResource (slug: vitae, max: 10, renew: false) only declares the bare pool; its schema (value, max, itemUUID, level, renew) has no field for a per-source gain/spend/reroll/choose trigger, so every Vitae-cost/-gain clause on every other card is inert as far as system.rules is concerned, and Bloom/Resonance/Load/Strain have no representation at all. Specifically, a GM-adjudicated permanent minor mutation grant from a homebrew table has no selector.
